pure_cancellation.scope: Same saved unmatched zero-search component intervals in both arms; only common-component uncertainty is removed. Additional common zero-search witnesses are offline audit costs, not deployment costs.
pure_cancellation.cost_scope: offline audit only; zero search expansion, common membership work/wall from source summary

strategy_contrast.scope: distinct bounding strategies; not isolated cancellation yield

seed_aggregation: per context arithmetic mean of all native seeds 1/2/3; failure zero; never best of three
selection_scope: frozen TRAIN-only programmes; analysis never mutates programme or data

completion.interpretation: execution completion is not solver success, optimality, source-feasibility or a paper-level claim

guarded_continuation_64.role: prespecified 64-node guarded continuation; TRAIN-bank index10, not test-selected

execution.full_interface_ablation_scope: identical declared AST; score_slice=false; no additional selection
execution.stochastic_primary: mean three seeds 1/2/3 with failure zero; completed-only mean separate
execution.budget_scope: official 5-second solver budget; constructive 5 CPU seconds cooperative; MILP 10 seconds; local search 2 seconds; not matched total computation
execution.input_freshness: caller validates input/source exclusion inventory and freeze before execution; no new input generation
